'''Armor-piercing grenades''', also known as '''AP grenades''', were a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Anti-Material grenade]]s and [[Model 9 armor piercing grenade]]s were both types of AP grenades manufactured by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]].
